description:
Recto (secondary use): 

Inventory belonging to the synagogue of the Iraqis in Fustat. Dated: 8 Tammuz 1391 Seleucid = 28 June 1080 CE. The inventory is of items from the Babylonian synagogue in Fusṭāṭ that had been stored in the Palestinian synagogue. The list includes a great many books, including a 'codex of the Torah said to be in Rabbenu Saʿadya's handwriting' (ie in the handwriting of Saʿadya Gaʾon, line 18).

(Information from CUDL, Goitein, and S. Reif, Published Material from the Cambridge Genizah Collection.)
